skills.name: Love Waves
skills.description:
Angela sends <font color='#404495'>(Love Waves)</font> in the target direction, dealing 170<font color='#27C0C7'>( +80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Lover's Mark)</font> (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of <font color='#404495'>(Lover's Mark)</font> increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s.
<font color='#404495'>(Love Waves)</font> also restore 150<font color='#27C0C7'>( +75% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill and the recharge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.
skills.tips: Try to store as many charges as you can before attacking, as high stacks of Lover's Mark can result in very impressive damage.

skills.name: Puppet-on-a-String
skills.description:
Angela launches a <font color='#404495'>(Puppet String)</font> at the target enemy, dealing 300<font color='#27C0C7'>( +40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and dealt 450<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>.
Each stack of <font color='#404495'>(Lover's Mark)</font> increases the final damage by 20%.
skills.tips: The follow-up damage dealt when connected is quite high, so try to stay as close to the target as possible.

skills.name: Heartguard
skills.description:
Angela begins channeling, applying a 1000<font color='#27C0C7'>( +200% Total Magic Power)</font> shield that lasts 6s to the target allied hero regardless of distance. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 12s, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost.
Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.
skills.tips: Protecting low-HP teammates in the nick of time can be very effective in turning the tide of battle.

skills.name: Smart Heart
skills.description: Angela gains 7.5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 30%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.
skills.tips: Using skills increases her movement speed. Attached allies also benefit from this speed increase.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.des: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.

items.name: Necklace of Durance
items.des: Unique Passive - Gift: Regenerates 20% Max HP and Mana over 2s after leveling up.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

builds.tips: Defense, Damage, and Healing In the early game, Enchanted Talisman can provide you with high cooldown reduction and mana regeneration, Concentrated Energy can strengthen your healing power and survivability, and Dominance Ice combined with Oracle can provide double resistances, while also helping you to reach max cooldown reduction, turning you into a highly resilient, damage-dealing, healing machine.
